8 things to teach them before they leave your house. 📦 You won't be there for every choice, so pack these in the box.

Jude is eighteen. The night before he leaves, Mom packs one more box, and with every item, a lesson:
✅ Watch what people do, not just what they say. 👓
✅ Don't trade your future. Real friends won't ask you to. 🧭
✅ Walk away from anything that pulls you down.
✅ Your mind matters. You don't have to pretend you're fine. 📱
✅ Money doesn't grow on trees. 🐷
✅ Choices have consequences. Some take years to fix.
✅ You can always come home. 🏠

Three months later, Jude's world is falling apart. At 2:40 AM, he's back at the kitchen table with Mom. ☕ She won't always know the way. But God will.

"Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and do not lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make straight your paths." Proverbs 3:5-6 (ESV) 🙏 Jesus gave His life so the door would always be open.

You're not raising kids who never need you. You're raising young adults who know where to come back to. ❤️ And these lessons start long before eighteen. At six, the big world is already scary.
